author: Ari Koslow
title: Sean Manaea to start in doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Sean Manaea will start one of the two games in Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Manaea and Nolan McLean will each start one of the two games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nolan McLean to start one of Wednesday doubleheader games
desc: Nolan McLean will start one of the two games in Wednesday's doubleheader for the Mets.
impact: McLean and Sean Manaea will take the mound for the two games. It is unclear who will start which game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kodai Senga to start Tuesday
desc: Kodai Senga will start on Tuesday against the Mets.
impact: Senga will remain the starter of the first game of the series after Monday's game was postponed. Nolan McLean and Sean Manaea will pitch the two games of Wednesday's doubleheader.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Javier Assad to start in doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Javier Assad will start one of the two games for the Cubs in Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Edward Cabrera will remain the starter on Tuesday. Shota Imanaga is starting the other game on Wednesday after Monday's game was postponed.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shota Imanaga to start one of Wednesday's doubleheader games
desc: Shota Imanaga will start one of the two games of Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Imanaga was scheduled to start on Sunday and Monday, both of which got postponed. Javier Assad will start the other game of the doubleheader.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edward Cabrera to remain starter Tuesday
desc: Edward Cabrera will remain the starter in Tuesday's game against the Mets.
impact: Cabrera will make his return from the injured list. Shota Imanaga will start one of Wednesday's doubleheader games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Garrett Crochet (shoulder) not cleared to resume throwing
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Garrett Crochet won't begin throwing yet.
impact: Crochet was re-evaluated on Monday and it showed that he is "improving," but not enough to resume throwing.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Romy Gonzalez (shoulder/hip) to continue rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Romy Gonzalez will continue his rehab assignment on Tuesday with Triple-A Worcester.
impact: Gonzalez went through a full workout on Monday. He's cleared after missing the weekend due to a hip issue.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Holliday (groin) remains out of lineup Monday
desc: Jackson Holliday remains out of the Orioles lineup on Monday against the Angels.
impact: Holliday had been hopeful to be available off the bench on Sunday. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Steele (elbow) starts throwing progression
desc: Justin Steele has started a throwing progression.
impact: Steele is working his way back from a setback when he was diagnosed with a flexor strain. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase DeLauter (rib) hopeful to return on upcoming homestand
desc: Guardians manager Stephen Vogt said the team is hopeful for Chase DeLauter to return on the upcoming homestand.
impact: DeLauter is working his way back from a small fracture in his right rib cage. He has been hitting, running and throwing.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jack Perkins offers mixed results Sunday against Angels
desc: Jack Perkins allowed four earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out eight over five innings in Sunday's loss to the Angels.
impact: Perkins has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander remains a high-risk starting option despite flashing elite strikeout potential for manager Mark Kotsay, posting a 6.26 ERA and 1.37 WHIP with a 2-3 record, two holds, three saves, and a 11.1 K/9 ratio through 21 appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Cronenworth (concussion) nearing rehab assignment
desc: Jake Cronenworth is getting close to starting a rehab assignment.
impact: Cronenworth has been on the injured list since early May. He is facing live pitching while he is rehabbing in Arizona.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dillon Dingler drives in two in win over White Sox
desc: Dillon Dingler went 2-for-5 in a win over the White Sox with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Dingler continues a productive stretch at the plate, collecting hits in nine of his last 11 contests. The catcher remains one of the few stable options in the Tigers lineup to this point, carrying an .884 OPS with 18 home runs, 55 RBI, and 40 runs scored across 70 games.
